q4_realtime_vs_offline_analysis.question: Why use Deepgram streaming for Q4 live nudges instead of Whisper Large V3 Turbo?
q4_realtime_vs_offline_analysis.decision: Use Deepgram Nova-3 for sub-second live telephony nudges; use Whisper Large V3 Turbo as the offline reference audit engine.

streaming_pipeline_metrics.notes: Agent receives nudge within 300ms of utterance completion, well before the call ends.

offline_transformer_metrics.notes: Sequence-to-sequence beam search incurs buffer latency that prevents real-time proactive intervention during active turns.

ai4bharat_indic_conformer.purpose: Indian regional market expansion (22 scheduled languages, 16kHz mono CTC/RNNT).
ai4bharat_indic_conformer.feasibility: Demonstrates capability to extend speech pipeline to South Asian financial markets.

ai4bharat_indic_f5.purpose: State-of-the-art multilingual speech synthesis for Indian subcontinent banking bots.

BAAI/bge-m3.intended_role: Multilingual dense + sparse semantic representation for Q2 retrieval
pros: Unifies English, Tagalog, and Indonesian into identical dense vector space
Eliminates vocabulary mismatch between English loan policies and Taglish/Bahasa questions
Multi-functionality: dense vectors, lexical sparse weights, and multi-vector ColBERT style
cons: Higher CPU embedding inference latency than quantized MiniLM (~40ms vs ~5ms)

BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3.intended_role: Second-stage reranker replacing heuristic score adjustments
pros: Direct cross-attention between customer question and policy text
Significantly higher precision on numeric thresholds and eligibility clauses
cons: Quadratic compute complexity with document length

openai/whisper-large-v3-turbo.intended_role: Offline ground-truth reference ASR for transcript audit & WER calculation
pros: High accuracy on Southeast Asian code-switching and financial jargon
4x faster than Whisper Large V3 with minimal degradation in WER
cons: Non-streaming architecture introduces 400-800ms chunk latency; unsuited for Q4 live nudges

openai/whisper-large-v3.intended_role: Maximum accuracy reference benchmark for speech transcription
cons: Compute intensive; high GPU VRAM requirement (10GB+)

facebook/mms-tts-tgl.intended_role: Self-hosted edge Tagalog TTS alternative for strict financial data sovereignty
pros: Extremely lightweight (36M params), executes on modest CPU in ~45ms
Zero per-minute cloud API costs; zero customer PII leaves enterprise network
cons: Slightly robotic prosody compared to generative diffusion voices (ElevenLabs)

facebook/mms-tts-ind.intended_role: Self-hosted edge Indonesian TTS alternative compliant with local banking data laws
pros: Full compliance with Indonesian banking data residency regulations
cons: Limited emotional inflection when delivering banking reassurance statements

ai4bharat/indic-conformer-600m-multiling.intended_role: Regional expansion research: Indic language conversational ASR
pros: Covers 22 scheduled Indian languages; 16kHz mono conformer architecture
cons: Does not support Tagalog or Indonesian; scoped as regional expansion research

ai4bharat/IndicF5.intended_role: Regional expansion research: Multilingual Indian TTS trained on 1,417 hours
pros: State-of-the-art prosody for Indian regional financial services
cons: Out of scope for core PH/ID markets
